source_mappings.Sector: Phase-1 project-level static field observed on the snapshot row; one-hot encoded.
source_mappings.Agency: Phase-1 project-level static field observed on the snapshot row; one-hot encoded.
source_mappings.Project_Status: Status attached to this snapshot only; one-hot encoded. Terminal Completed snapshots are excluded from training.
source_mappings.original_cost_crore: Original_Cost_Crore on the current snapshot row.
source_mappings.revised_budget_crore: Revised_or_Anticipated_Cost_Crore on the current snapshot row; never forward-filled from later revisions.
source_mappings.revised_budget_to_original_ratio: Current revised budget divided by current original cost when original cost > 0.
source_mappings.cumulative_expenditure_crore: Cumulative_Expenditure_Crore on the current snapshot row.
source_mappings.expenditure_ratio: Current cumulative expenditure divided by current original cost when original cost > 0.
source_mappings.expenditure_lag_1m_crore: Last expenditure observation at or before snapshot minus 1 month, within a 45-day match window. Missing if no such history.
source_mappings.expenditure_lag_3m_crore: Last expenditure observation at or before snapshot minus 3 months, within a 45-day match window. Missing if no such history.
source_mappings.expenditure_lag_6m_crore: Last expenditure observation at or before snapshot minus 6 months, within a 45-day match window. Missing if no such history.
source_mappings.expenditure_velocity_crore_per_month: Change in expenditure from the 1-month lag divided by elapsed months between those two dates.
source_mappings.expenditure_growth_1m_pct: Percent change in expenditure versus the 1-month lag.
source_mappings.expenditure_growth_3m_pct: Percent change in expenditure versus the 3-month lag.
source_mappings.expenditure_3m_trend_crore_per_month: Expenditure change versus the 3-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.expenditure_6m_trend_crore_per_month: Expenditure change versus the 6-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.expenditure_rolling_mean_6m_crore: Mean of finite expenditure values with Snapshot_Date in (t-6 months, t].
source_mappings.expenditure_rolling_volatility_6m_crore: Sample standard deviation of those same trailing-six-month expenditure values.
source_mappings.expenditure_observations_6m: Count of finite expenditure values in the trailing six-month window.
source_mappings.months_since_expenditure_update: Months between the snapshot and the latest finite expenditure at or before t.
source_mappings.physical_progress_pct: Physical_Progress (%) on the snapshot row; values outside [0, 100] are missing.
source_mappings.physical_progress_lag_1m_pct: Physical progress at the 1-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.physical_progress_lag_3m_pct: Physical progress at the 3-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.physical_progress_lag_6m_pct: Physical progress at the 6-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.physical_progress_velocity_pct_per_month: Change in physical progress versus the 1-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.physical_progress_acceleration_pct_per_m: Current physical-progress velocity minus the prior snapshot's velocity; both velocities use only dates <= t.
source_mappings.physical_progress_rolling_trend_6m_pct_p: Physical-progress change versus the 6-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_pct: Milestone_Percent on the snapshot row; values outside [0, 100] are missing.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_lag_1m_pct: Milestone progress at the 1-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_lag_3m_pct: Milestone progress at the 3-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_lag_6m_pct: Milestone progress at the 6-month as-of lag, or missing.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_velocity_pct_per_mont: Change in milestone progress versus the 1-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_acceleration_pct_per_: Current milestone velocity minus the prior snapshot's velocity.
source_mappings.milestone_progress_rolling_trend_6m_pct_: Milestone-progress change versus the 6-month lag divided by elapsed months.
source_mappings.progress_current_pct: Physical progress if finite, otherwise milestone progress, both from the current snapshot.
source_mappings.progress_velocity_pct_per_month: Physical-progress velocity if finite, otherwise milestone-progress velocity.
source_mappings.progress_acceleration_pct_per_month2: Physical-progress acceleration if finite, otherwise milestone-progress acceleration.
source_mappings.progress_rolling_trend_6m_pct_per_month: Physical-progress 6-month trend if finite, otherwise milestone-progress 6-month trend.
source_mappings.months_since_physical_progress_update: Months since the latest finite physical-progress value at or before t.
source_mappings.months_since_milestone_progress_update: Months since the latest finite milestone-progress value at or before t.
source_mappings.months_since_progress_update: Months since the latest finite physical or milestone progress at or before t.
source_mappings.planned_duration_months: Original_DoC minus Date_of_Approval in months, using only dates on the current row; approval dates after t are treated as unknown.
source_mappings.elapsed_since_approval_months: Snapshot_Date minus Date_of_Approval when approval is known and <= t.
source_mappings.schedule_slippage_months: Snapshot minus current-row revised DoC, else original DoC; positive means the snapshot is after the planned date.
source_mappings.revised_doc_shift_from_original_months: Current-row revised DoC minus current-row original DoC.
source_mappings.revised_doc_movement_1m_months: Change in the as-of revised DoC versus the 1-month lag row; later revisions are not used.
source_mappings.delay_growth_1m_months: Current schedule slippage minus slippage at the 1-month lag snapshot.
source_mappings.delay_growth_3m_months: Current schedule slippage minus slippage at the 3-month lag snapshot.
source_mappings.delay_growth_6m_months: Current schedule slippage minus slippage at the 6-month lag snapshot.
source_mappings.milestone_slippage_vs_elapsed_pct_points: Current milestone percent minus expected percent from elapsed/planned duration, clipped to [0, 100].
source_mappings.months_since_status_update: Months since the latest non-missing Project_Status at or before t.
source_mappings.status_changes_6m: Count of observed Project_Status transitions in (t-6 months, t].
source_mappings.status_change_frequency_6m: status_changes_6m divided by the span of the trailing status window in months.
source_mappings.status_recently_changed: 1 if a status transition occurred within 1.5 months before t, else 0 when enough history exists.
source_mappings.history_months_available: Months between this snapshot and the project's first valid snapshot.
source_mappings.lookback_observation_count_6m: Number of snapshots in (t-6 months, t], including the current row.

missing_history_policy: No minimum history; unavailable lags and rolling statistics are left missing and imputed inside each CV fold. No forward fill.
